strings.text: Count primary hits per weapon instance and enemy. Each hit renews the 4 s window. On the third hit, 0.6 D bonus damage follows immediately on the same target; the counter then resets to 0. No carry-over between enemies or weapons.
Steady damage against tough single targets
Push every normal target hit 80 units radially away from the impact center, then slow it by 20% for 2 s. Bosses are not pushed but receive a 10% slow.

After the primary hit, the clapper flies to the nearest enemy not yet hit within 140 units. Up to two follow-up targets for 0.6 D and 0.36 D damage. The target is chosen anew for each leap; no tracking during flight. No further targets: remove it.
Afflict every target hit with Weakness for 2.5 s: the damage it deals drops by 20%. For bosses, 10%.
After the main damage, afflict targets hit with Brittle for 3 s: +10% incoming hero damage; for bosses +5%. The triggering hit itself does not yet receive this bonus.

A pitch circle of radius 60 remains at the impact point for 3 s. Inside it, 30% movement slow, 15% for bosses. It ends immediately on leaving. No area damage. On a third field, remove the oldest of this weapon instance.
Ignites targets hit for 3 s. Six burn ticks of 0.15 D each, first tick after 0.5 s. Burn refreshes according to the shared status rules.

If the target burns before the primary hit: capture the remaining unexecuted burn ticks before any status changes. After the main damage, remove the burn and deal 50% of that remaining base damage at once, at most 1.5 D of the Snuffer Club. No burn: no bonus damage.

The first three enemy projectiles blocked in the active front arc per shield activation are destroyed and replaced by one hero projectile each. The return flight is exactly opposite the incoming direction; damage is 16 x weapon tier factor x (1 + damage bonus), rounded up. Afterwards the shield keeps blocking without reflection. No crits, no triggering of other weapon effects.

0.45 s after the main active phase begins, a copy of the original beam rectangle hits once for 0.5 D. Freeze origin, direction, width and range from the activation. The copy checks all living enemies in the rectangle at its own time; the primary hit is not a requirement.
If the target's health fraction immediately before the primary hit is at most 35%, 0.35 D bonus damage follows. Also applies to bosses; no instant kill and no percent-max-health damage.

Every third actual activation fires five instead of three primary projectiles at angles -30/-15/0/15/30°. Damage, radius, speed and range unchanged. Shared primary hit list: still at most one primary hit per target per activation. Counter starts at 0.

The third hit of the same instance on the same target within a renewed 4 s window roots it for 0.7 s, then the counter resets to 0. Afterwards the target has 3 s of global root immunity. On immunity, also reset the counter. Bosses receive a 10% slow for 0.7 s instead of the root.

If the target is at least at 65% of the effective range along the attack direction at the primary hit, 0.4 D bonus damage follows. Measure distance as the projection of the target center onto the frozen attack axis.
Afflicts every target hit with Rend for 3 s: six ticks of 0.12 D each, first tick after 0.5 s. This is escaping wish energy, with no depiction of blood.
Targets hit move 25% slower for 3 s, bosses 12.5%. The stickiness is no additional damage and does not change enemy windup times.

The primary projectile hits up to three different targets on the same straight flight path. Primary hit damage in order 1 D / 0.8 D / 0.6 D. Remove after the third hit or at end of range. Each primary hit can crit separately; globally once per target and activation.
If the target has an active Rend immediately before the primary hit, 0.3 D bonus damage follows. The Rend remains and is not refreshed.

After the hit, place a 4 s bookmark. The next primary hit by a DIFFERENT weapon instance of the same hero consumes it and additionally deals 0.5 D of the marking Fold Blade, stored when placed. Only one bookmark per target; placing again replaces the old one. Marking and triggering within the same hit processing are forbidden.

After the impact, a 3 s ink circle of radius 60 remains. Enemies inside deal 20% less damage, bosses 10%. Leaving ends this source immediately. No additional ground damage. At most two fields per instance, replace the oldest.

Link the target hit with the nearest other living enemy within 160 units for 3 s. At most one pair per instance, a new hit replaces it; without a partner no new link. Primary hit damage on one partner transfers 30% of the health actually lost to the other, at most 0.6 D of the Needle Thrower at link time. At most one transfer per pair every 0.5 s. Only primary hits after linking count. The link ends when a partner dies or the distance exceeds 240 units. Multiple links on the same target: only the oldest valid, ready link reacts to this primary hit. On a lethal primary hit, a pre-existing link may transfer its main health loss exactly once more; only then is it removed.
Only the first primary hit of each activation afflicts its target and up to the three nearest other enemies within radius 80 with Rend: six ticks of 0.08 D each over 3 s. No instant bonus hits.

Pull normal enemies hit over 0.2 s by up to 40 units toward Knorz's position at the time of the hit. Stop at the latest at the sum of both body radii plus 8 units of distance. Bosses immune; attacks are not interrupted.

The active beam rectangle additionally destroys the first two enemy projectiles whose center it touches. No reflection. Hit order by contact time, then projectile ID. The limit applies across the whole active phase.
After main damage, afflict enemies hit with Brittle for 2 s: +20% incoming hero damage, +10% for bosses. Overlap with other Brittle sources follows the strongest source.

Each primary projectile leaves a shard at its endpoint on hit or at end of range. Armed after 0.25 s; explodes at the first living enemy center within radius 45 or after 3 s in total, each time once for 0.35 D. Even with three shards per volley, each target receives at most one shard bonus hit of this activation. At most nine shards per instance; remove the oldest harmlessly when exceeded.

0.35 s after the main strike, a ring hits around its frozen impact center. The target center must be farther than 65 and at most 130 units away. Once 0.4 D per target. Targets hit before can also be hit when moving into the ring.

The orbiting tile destroys the first three enemy projectiles whose center touches the moving tile circle of radius 14. The whole orbit circle is not a barrier. Main damage against enemies remains unchanged.

Every third activation strengthens all primary hits to 1.5 D and roots normal enemies hit for 0.35 s. Respect the global root immunity of 3 s afterwards. Bosses receive a 10% slow for 0.35 s instead. The damage also applies during root immunity. Counter starts at 0.

Each primary hit adds one global Sand Load stack per target, at most five. Each stack lowers movement by 5%, 2.5% for bosses. Each new hit renews the shared duration to 3 s, then all stacks expire together. Multiple Sand Spitters share this stack pool.

After a fully completed orbit, Knorz gains +15 percentage points of attack speed for 2 s. The trigger has a 4 s cooldown per weapon instance. Multiple Balance Discs do not stack the bonus; the longest remaining duration applies. No retroactive shortening of running cooldowns; new activations compute their interval with the current bonus. The Mirror Shield keeps its fixed cooldown.

Place a 2 s time mark. When it expires, the still-living target suffers 0.75 D once, stored when placed. While this instance has a mark there, further hits are ignored without renewal. Death removes the mark without an area effect. Other instances may place their own marks.
Ignites enemies hit for 2 s: four burn ticks of 0.2 D each, first tick after 0.5 s. The same burn status as the Wick Lance; sources do not add up.
If the target burns immediately before the primary hit, 0.5 D bonus damage follows. The burn is neither consumed nor refreshed.

Per activation, on the first primary hit against an already burning target: ignite up to three nearest other enemies within 120 units for 2 s with four ticks of 0.1 D of the Ash Scatterer each. The source itself receives no new burn. If there is no burning primary target, no spread.

On the primary projectile hit, an explosion of radius 70 appears around the impact point. All other enemy centers inside suffer 0.5 D once. The primary target is excluded from this explosion. At end of range without a hit, no explosion.
Every fourth activation deals 1.5 D main damage and afflicts enemies hit with +10% incoming hero damage for 3 s afterwards, bosses +5%. Other activations unchanged. Counter starts at 0.

Heal Knorz for 6% of the target health actually lost by this primary hit, rounded up, at most 2 health in total per activation. Nothing is stored beyond healing at full health. Secondary damage, status ticks, shield and overkill damage do not heal.
After the primary hit, bonus damage follows equal to min(2% of the target's maximum health, 0.5 D), rounded up. Applies with the identical cap to bosses. No armor penetration and no instant kill.

0.6 s after the main active phase begins, a second three-projectile volley appears at the frozen firing point with the original direction and range, 0.4 D each. Radius 7, speed 380, no pierce. Shared echo hit list: each target at most once per echo volley; it may have been hit by the main volley before.
